messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — last-minute ask. I have a personal appointment tomorrow and need someone to swap primary for the 12:00–20:00 UTC window. I'm currently primary for that shift. Can anyone cover?
Liam O'Connor: I can take that, assuming secondary coverage stays intact. Which runbook should I follow for handoff notes?
Maya Chen: Thanks Liam. Please follow the standard oncall handoff runbook, see link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoffs — key items: current open incidents, paging escalation levels, active canaries, and any in-progress rollouts.
Sophia Patel: @Liam quick Q: do you need the creds for the private deployment test accounts? I can add you to the k8s dashboard if you need.
Liam O'Connor: Would be helpful to have access to the eu-west cluster logs and the dedupe/alerting dashboard. If Sophia can grant, that should be enough.
Sophia Patel: I'll invite you to the org group, liam@redwood. Also dropping the runbook snippet here for quick reference:
```
Handoff checklist:
- Current primary: update calendar + slack status
- Incident list: link each open alert + owner
- Pending changes: rollback/hold for duration of handoff
- Escalation: pager -> phone -> VP on-call (threshold: >10% SLO breach for 5m)
- Contact list: SRE, Platform, Prod Eng
```
Jordan Reyes: FYI, there's a flaky 5xx spike yesterday on hosted inference in eu-west that was mitigated by scaling up the smaller model pool. I'll paste the alert: incident-1234 in case you need context.
incident-bot: Incident created: incident-1234 — high 5xx rate on /v1/generate (eu-west). Severity: P2. Opened by: infra-monitor. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/incident-1234
Maya Chen: Good call. Jordan — can you add a 2–3 line summary in the handoff doc about what we did and the mitigation timeline? That will help the person covering.
Jordan Reyes: Added: "Scaled model-pool-small by +30% at 2028-10-04T19:10Z, latency normalized within ~6m. Root cause suspected transient upstream storage IO. Action: monitor storage ops; no rollout required"
Liam O'Connor: Got it. Two follow-ups: 1) Do we want to enable the canary fallback policy for hosted -> dedicated for critical customers during my window? 2) Who's my secondary?
Maya Chen: Secondary will remain Sophia unless she opts out. Regarding canary fallback, recommend leaving current automatic fallback ON but set the threshold one notch tighter due to yesterday's spike. I'll make that config change before handoff.
Sophia Patel: I can be secondary. I'll stay available 12:30–18:30 UTC. If you need extended overlap, ping me.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks — I'll update my calendar and set Slack status. Also, can someone drop the exact commands for toggling the canary threshold?
Sophia Patel: Command is in infra toolbelt: `infra-tool set-fallback-threshold --service=hosted-inference --region=eu-west --threshold=0.05` (that sets 5% error rate tolerance). Use --dry-run first.
Maya Chen: I'll run the change and confirm here once done.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please add a short handoff note in /docs/oncall/handoffs/board. Template auto-saves.
Maya Chen: Done — updated the handoff doc with incident-1234 summary and that I scheduled liam as primary and sophia as secondary.
Liam O'Connor: All set on my end. Calendar updated, Slack status set to "on-call (primary) — 12:00–20:00 UTC". I've accepted the k8s dashboard invite.
Sophia Patel: Confirmed secondary is set. I'll monitor alerts 12:30–18:30 UTC and be reachable by phone if pager escalates.
Jordan Reyes: Quick note — if the 5xx resurges, first mitigation is to shift heavy traffic to dedicated capacity for affected customers (runbook step 4). I added the customer list to the incident doc.
Liam O'Connor: Understood. I'll keep the fallback and routing policy in mind. Any objections to doing a short 10m sync in #eng-oncall 10 minutes before my primary starts?
Maya Chen: Sounds good. Let's do 10:50 UTC quick sync. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark: 
Sophia Patel: 👍 :eyes:
incident-bot: Reminder: On-call rotation change detected — Maya Chen -> Liam O'Connor at 2028-10-05T12:00Z. Pager routing updated.
Liam O'Connor: Received the notification. I'll be online and watching alerts. If anything urgent pops, page me directly or escalate per runbook.
Maya Chen: Appreciate it — leaving my status open for questions until 12:05 UTC. Thanks team for the quick swap.
